mandate.promise: Know what changed, why it matters, and what to watch next.
mandate.proof: Every important conclusion carries evidence, invalidation, timestamp, and outcome history.
mandate.icp: Self-directed, research-intensive swing/position investors following 10–100 names.
mandate.first_paid_job: Continuously monitor what matters to my holdings/watchlist and tell me when the causal picture changes.

north_star.metric: Day-90 retained contribution profit generated by activated users attributable incrementally to Marketing
north_star.note: Accruing — requires two mature cohorts and holdout-validated incrementality. No data yet (wave0).

self_deception_checks.name: no_training_on_unverified_attribution
self_deception_checks.desc: The lobe does not train on its own unverified attribution as truth. Only holdout-validated incrementality results may update the model.
self_deception_checks.note: Growth Science department owns attribution; publishing depts are consumers only.

self_deception_checks.name: no_delete_losing_cells
self_deception_checks.desc: Losing experiment cells are never deleted. Append-only ledgers are the enforcement mechanism.
self_deception_checks.note: All ledgers are JSONL append-only; the auditor samples for deletions.

self_deception_checks.name: no_relabel_failed_metric_as_success
self_deception_checks.desc: A failed primary metric cannot be relabeled as a success after the fact. Pre-registered primary metric stays fixed for the experiment lifecycle.
self_deception_checks.note: Experiment registry records hypothesis+primary_metric before any result is written.

self_deception_checks.name: no_self_grading_by_publishing_dept
self_deception_checks.desc: A publishing department may not grade its own work alone. Attribution and scoring live in Growth Science.
self_deception_checks.note: Scorecard writes are gated to growth_science and office_cmo departments.

self_deception_checks.name: no_engagement_as_revenue_proxy
self_deception_checks.desc: Engagement (likes, views, clicks) may not claim revenue impact without holdout-validated evidence.
self_deception_checks.note: Incrementality holdout required before any engagement metric enters budget allocation.

self_deception_checks.name: no_creator_payout_ignoring_refunds
self_deception_checks.desc: Creator/referral conversions include payout, refund, and chargeback costs in retained_contribution before credit is assigned.
self_deception_checks.note: Economics formula always subtracts payouts and refunds before attribution.

self_deception_checks.name: no_marketing_response_changes_market_scores
self_deception_checks.desc: Marketing response (clicks, subs, revenue) cannot change a Neural Web market-engine score or signal.
self_deception_checks.note: Typed boundary between marketing control plane and scored-path surfaces.

self_deception_checks.name: no_authority_widening_on_anomalous_win
self_deception_checks.desc: Authority is not widened based on a single anomalous win. Minimum sample size and holdout validation are required.
self_deception_checks.note: Authority ladder gates: passed_shadow + clean_receipts + no_unresolved_corrections + survived_red_team.

waves.title: Root charter and inventory
waves.goal: Establish the sovereign lobe, exact current-state truth, department registry, growth authority ladder, and auditor charter. Lobe visible in Neural Web organization; Fable can create a department in shadow mode.

waves.title: Autonomous Growth OS
waves.goal: Make every action attributable, bounded, replayable, and recoverable. Build: Opportunity Bus, campaign compiler, provenance modes, Claim Passport, publication ledger, correction bus, experiment registry, budget allocator, policy compiler, human-exception queue, growth events.

waves.title: Commercial truth spine
waves.goal: Ensure traffic can become measurable retained revenue. Build: production billing, canonical offers, preview logic, refunds, identity/audience graph, consent, lifecycle events, attribution, cohort economics.

waves.title: Proof products
waves.goal: Create the highest-leverage public value objects: What Changed, Claim Passport / receipt page, Why Is It Moving?, share card and chart-as-URL, Stock Dossier, event impact map, watchlist monitoring bridge.

waves.title: Owned media machine
waves.goal: Make one worthy opportunity become a coherent owned distribution bundle: newsletter, flagship X desk, chart/receipt X desk, YouTube shorts, public SEO templates, structured data, newsroom.

waves.title: Ecosystem distribution
waves.goal: Make other people stronger because they distribute Mastermind intelligence: creator copilot, co-branded reports, partner ledger, Discord/Telegram, embed SDK, community configuration.

waves.title: Paid growth and autonomous scaling
waves.goal: Buy only what the organic system has proved: paid account adapters, retargeting, organic-winner promotion, incrementality holdouts, day-90 value forecasts, automatic scale and stop rules.

waves.title: Self-expanding institution
waves.goal: Allow Fable to create new growth organs autonomously: regional desks, product-led affiliate network, API distribution, adviser/professional offering, contributor marketplace.
